caveats: Region cells are the dataset grid cells whose centres fall inside the bounds (nearest-cell alignment; 60x60 cells, 3308 finite on every target day, 292 land/ice cells masked 0). Pools for the ±5-day windows at the ends of the baseline include the extra days 1991-12-27..1991-12-31 and 2003-01-01..2003-01-05 as prescribed; day-of-year 60 (29 Feb) has no pool and was filled with the mean of days 59 and 61 before smoothing. All 4018 baseline-window and 92 target daily files were present, and each file time coordinate was verified against its filename. Thresholds, climatology, smoothing and comparisons computed in float64; 90th percentile via numpy method="hazen" (Hyndman-Fan type 5, MATLAB quantile default); centred 31-day moving mean verified against an explicit brute-force circular-window computation.
